fields.label: Toggle keybind
fields.description: Hyprland bind syntax (e.g. "SUPER + SHIFT + V") for opening/closing the special-workspace group. Always jumps to slot 1 when opening. Needs 'hyprctl reload' to apply -- triggered automatically when this is saved.

fields.label: Hidden-group threshold
fields.description: Real workspace numbers above this become the hidden special group (slot 1 = threshold+1, slot 2 = threshold+2, ...). Everything at or below it is a normal, visible workspace. Needs 'hyprctl reload' to apply -- triggered automatically when this is saved.

fields.label: Unlimited special workspaces
fields.description: When on, the special group has no fixed size -- SUPER+Z/X and scrolling can always create one more slot past the last occupied one. Turn off to use a fixed slot count instead, which enables wraparound (last slot back to slot 1, and vice versa).

fields.label: Fixed slot count
fields.description: Only used when 'Unlimited special workspaces' is off.

fields.label: Special-group entry/exit animation
fields.description: Animation used only for the toggle keybind's transition into/out of the group (navigation within the group uses your normal workspace animation).
